# Instructions

This is a TypeScript library that resolves social post URLs to direct media
URLs. Development uses Bun as the runtime and test runner.

The rules live in the documents below. Read the one that matches the task and do
not copy its rules here.

- Setup, checks, code style and commit rules:
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Documentation index: [docs/readme.md](../docs/readme.md)
- Adding or changing an extractor: [docs/extractors.md](../docs/extractors.md)
- Tests, cassettes and recording: [docs/testing.md](../docs/testing.md)
- Fixture output and live checks: [docs/eval.md](../docs/eval.md)
- Error types: [docs/errors.md](../docs/errors.md)
- Instagram: [docs/instagram.md](../docs/instagram.md)

Run `bun run check` and `bun run test` before you finish.
